description: Manifest and storage contract for structure-derived atom/void graphs with per-void ELF targets.

manifest.one_row_per: variant directory containing POSCAR and/or ELFCAR

sample_id.meaning: Stable ID from SHA-256 of source-relative sample directory.

family_id.meaning: Stable split group ID from normalized parent phase directory name; category is excluded.

structure_family_id.meaning: Alias of family_id for clarity in downstream consumers.

category.meaning: First relative path component, e.g. 2 or Mono.

poscar_sha256.meaning: SHA-256 of original POSCAR; null when missing or hashing disabled.

elfcar_sha256.meaning: SHA-256 of original ELFCAR; null when missing or hashing disabled.

atom_count.meaning: Number of atoms parsed from POSCAR counts.

element_symbols.meaning: Element labels from POSCAR (empty for VASP4 style).

processing_status.meaning: ready means the POSCAR/ELFCAR pair and headers parsed; processed means graph and targets were written; failed or failed_processing means an input or processing step failed.

failure_reason.meaning: Input, parse, hash or processing error; null on success.

graph_storage.coordinate_convention: Fractional coordinates in the original POSCAR basis; periodic image shifts are integer lattice translations.

voids.orbit_id: UTF-8 [n_voids]; common ID for members generated from one symmetry-reduced candidate
voids.orbit_member_index: integer [n_voids]; zero-based position in the sorted unique orbit members
voids.orbit_multiplicity: integer [n_voids]; number of explicit unique unit-cell nodes in this orbit, repeated on every member

void_void.self_edge_policy: exclude zero-shift self edges; retain translated periodic self images
void_void.node_basis: all explicit unique void members in the unit cell, including within-cell symmetry images

edge_types.directed_edge_convention: image_shift is added to destination fractional coordinates; all destination images within the configured cutoff are stored. Relations store both directions when applicable; derive atom-to-void by reversing endpoints and negating image_shift.

per_void_arrays.elf_at_center: float [n_voids]; periodic trilinear interpolation of ELFCAR total grid
per_void_arrays.elf_max_0.5A: float [n_voids]; raw local grid maximum within 0.5 angstrom
per_void_arrays.elf_max_1A: float [n_voids]; raw local grid maximum within 1.0 angstrom
per_void_arrays.elf_max_1.5A: float [n_voids]; raw local grid maximum within 1.5 angstrom
per_void_arrays.offset_0.5A: float [n_voids,3]; Cartesian offset vector to local maximum in angstrom
per_void_arrays.offset_1A: float [n_voids,3]; Cartesian offset vector to local maximum in angstrom
per_void_arrays.offset_1.5A: float [n_voids,3]; Cartesian offset vector to local maximum in angstrom
per_void_arrays.void_dimension: int8 [n_voids]; periodic accessible-space winding rank 0-3; -1 if candidate center maps to an inactive voxel
per_void_arrays.void_dimension_valid: uint8 [n_voids]; 1 if candidate center maps to an active component, otherwise 0

dimensionality.definition: nearest-atom clearance threshold, periodic six-neighbor accessible-voxel components, and rank of independent whole-cell winding vectors; geometric only, not ELF/electronic dimensionality

targets.caveat: Local maxima are not masked against atoms and may lie in atomic basins.

graph_storage.label_input_separation: ELFCAR-derived targets are labels and must not be supplied to the GNN as input features.

void_orbit_contract.expansion: Expand each symmetry-reduced candidate into all unique symmetry-generated positions wrapped into the unit cell before constructing void-atom and void-void edges and before calculating per-void labels.
void_orbit_contract.representative_order: Sort wrapped representative fractional coordinates lexicographically before assigning representative indexes.
void_orbit_contract.member_order: Sort unique wrapped orbit member fractional coordinates lexicographically before assigning orbit_member_index.

settings_fields.void_symmetry_tolerance_angstrom: positive float; deduplication tolerance used for symmetry-generated members
settings_fields.void_symmetry_operation_count: nonnegative integer; zero on symmetry-analysis fallback

void_orbit_contract.fallback_behavior: If symmetry analysis fails, keep each detected representative as a singleton orbit with member index 0 and multiplicity 1; include fallback status in per-sample settings metadata.
void_orbit_contract.consequence: Candidate void nodes correspond to physical unique void sites in the unit cell. ELF and dimensionality target arrays use this expanded node order; periodic image shifts then describe translations beyond the unit cell.

family_id_contract: The family key is the case-folded, whitespace-trimmed parent-phase directory name (the second relative path component). Category is deliberately excluded, so matching parent-phase names under categories such as 2 and Mono receive the same family_id and remain in one split. This relies on the ELFNet directory name being the cross-category phase identity.
split_policy: Assign all samples with a shared family_id to the same split.
